title: 21-21 Server-Side
description: For the 21-21 modded server. Currently only intended for Fabric 1.21.10
body:
### Intended only for Fabric 1.21.10
Notice: No current plans on updating to a different version.

For the 21-21 private modded server, server-side download only. 21-21 is focused on simple optimization, customizablity, quality of life tweaks, minor visual enhancements, and fun in a multiplayer world/server.

Labeled as server-side because it is meant to be paired with the client-side modpack.

<details>
